_note: Target ranges are starting points from fitter systems / literature, not validated standards. Edit freely. low or high may be null (one-sided). confidence: literature | rule_of_thumb | tracked_only. role: fix (drives advice) | hint (shown as a note only) | tracked (no judgement).

_sources.knee_flexion_bdc: Dynamic 2D at BDC ~8° above static Holmes 25-35°; suggested 33-43° (Acta Bioeng Biomech 2019). Retül ~35-40°.
_sources.hip_closed_tdc: Closed hip angle at top of stroke >=40°, 45° preferred (Working Triathlete 2023; BikeFittr 35-45°). Measured along the femur (shoulder-hip-knee): the article says pedal, but shoulder-hip-pedal at TDC is ~100°, so 40-45° only fits the femur line.
_sources.torso_angle: Velogic: elite 10-15°, general 20-30°; BikeFittr 20-35°, <20° linked to neck/shoulder pain.
_sources.shoulder_angle: Velogic tri metrics: shoulder angle avg 75-100°.
_sources.forearm_angle: Velogic forearm 0-20° (start 5-10°); high-hands trend 5-25° extension tilt.
_sources.upper_arm_angle: Upper arm vertical to 10-20° forward (fitter guides).
_sources.knee_elbow_gap_mm: No published range; only a clearance check.

knee_flexion_bdc.label: 膝彎曲角 @BDC (動態)
knee_flexion_bdc.why: 踏板最低點(BDC)時膝蓋的彎曲量,反映座墊高度。目標 33–43°(理想 38°):傳統靜態量測的標準範圍是 25–35°,但騎行中的動態拍攝通常比靜態多約 8°,所以取 33–43°(Acta Bioeng Biomech 2019);Retül 常用約 35–40°。依據:文獻,仍只是起點,不是驗證過的標準。
knee_flexion_bdc.why_en: Knee bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke (BDC); reflects saddle height. Target 33–43° (ideal 38°): the classic static range is 25–35°, but dynamic measurement while riding reads about 8° higher, hence 33–43° (Acta Bioeng Biomech 2019); Retül typically uses ~35–40°. Basis: literature, still a starting point rather than a validated standard.

hip_closed_tdc.label: 閉合髖角 @TDC (肩-髖-膝)
hip_closed_tdc.why: 踏板最高點(TDC)時肩-髖-膝的夾角(沿大腿量)。目標 ≥ 40°,偏好約 45°:太閉會壓縮腹部、影響呼吸與功率(Working Triathlete 2023;BikeFittr 建議 35–45°)。因為是沿大腿量,40–45° 才合理(肩-髖-踏板約 100°)。依據:經驗法則。
hip_closed_tdc.why_en: Shoulder-hip-knee angle at the top of the pedal stroke (TDC), measured along the femur. Target ≥ 40°, preferably ~45°: too closed squeezes the abdomen and hurts breathing and power (Working Triathlete 2023; BikeFittr suggests 35–45°). Measured along the thigh, 40–45° is the sensible range (shoulder-hip-pedal would be ~100°). Basis: rule of thumb.

knee_elbow_gap_mm.label: 膝-手肘最小間距 @TDC
knee_elbow_gap_mm.why: TDC 時膝蓋與手肘之間的最小距離。目標 ≥ 25 mm,只是避免膝蓋碰到手肘的安全間距。沒有公開標準。依據:經驗法則。
knee_elbow_gap_mm.why_en: Smallest distance between knee and elbow at TDC. Target ≥ 25 mm, just a clearance check so the knee doesn't hit the elbow. No published standard. Basis: rule of thumb.

shoulder_angle.label: 肩角 (軀幹-上臂)
shoulder_angle.why: 軀幹與上臂的夾角,反映手墊離肩膀的遠近。目標 75–100°(理想 88°),取自 Velogic 鐵人三項 fit 的平均範圍。依據:經驗法則。
shoulder_angle.why_en: Angle between torso and upper arm; reflects how far the pads sit from the shoulders. Target 75–100° (ideal 88°), from the average range in Velogic's triathlon fit metrics. Basis: rule of thumb.

upper_arm_angle.label: 上臂偏離垂直 (向前為正)
upper_arm_angle.why: 上臂對垂直線的角度,向前為正;0° 表示手肘在肩膀正下方。目標 −5–20°(理想 8°),依 fitter 指南的「從垂直到前傾 10–20°」。職業選手分兩種風格(手肘在肩下或肩前),稍微超出不必硬追。依據:經驗法則。
upper_arm_angle.why_en: Upper-arm angle from vertical, forward positive; 0° means the elbow is directly below the shoulder. Target −5–20° (ideal 8°), based on fitter guides' "vertical to 10–20° forward". Pros split into two styles (elbows under or ahead of the shoulders), so a small excess is not worth chasing. Basis: rule of thumb.

torso_angle.label: 軀幹對水平角
torso_angle.why: 背部與水平線的夾角,越小越平、風阻越低、越吃柔軟度。目標 20–35°:Velogic 認為菁英約 10–15°、一般 20–30°;BikeFittr 建議 20–35°,低於 20° 與頸肩痠痛有關。只當提示,不列入調整順序。依據:經驗法則。
torso_angle.why_en: Angle between back and horizontal; smaller is flatter, less drag, and demands more flexibility. Target 20–35°: Velogic puts elites around 10–15° and general riders at 20–30°; BikeFittr suggests 20–35°, and below 20° is linked to neck/shoulder pain. Shown as a hint only, not part of the adjustment order. Basis: rule of thumb.

forearm_angle.label: 前臂上翹角 (對水平)
forearm_angle.why: 前臂相對水平的上翹量,由延伸把的傾角決定。目標 0–25°:Velogic 建議 0–20°(起點 5–10°),高手位的趨勢是延伸把上翹 5–25°;UCI 上限約 30°。只當提示。依據:經驗法則。
forearm_angle.why_en: Upward tilt of the forearm relative to horizontal, set by the extension angle. Target 0–25°: Velogic suggests 0–20° (start at 5–10°), and the high-hands trend is 5–25° of extension tilt; the UCI limit is about 30°. Shown as a hint only. Basis: rule of thumb.

elbow_angle.label: 手肘角
elbow_angle.why: 手肘的彎曲角度。只追蹤,沒有目標範圍;通常隨前臂與軀幹的調整一起變化,不單獨調。
elbow_angle.why_en: Elbow bend angle. Tracked only, no target range; it usually changes along with forearm and torso adjustments and is not adjusted on its own.

ankle_angle_bdc.label: 踝角 @BDC
ankle_angle_bdc.why: BDC 時的踝關節角度。只追蹤,沒有目標範圍;受鞋、扣片和踩踏習慣影響,2D 影像的誤差也大。
ankle_angle_bdc.why_en: Ankle angle at BDC. Tracked only, no target range; it depends on shoes, cleats and pedalling style, and 2D video error is large.
